column1: a|/ə; eɪ/|art.|一个；某一|基础|function-reference|a book::一本书;a little::一点|There is a small shop near the station.::车站附近有一家小商店。|She works as a teacher in our town.::她在我们镇上当老师。
the|/ðə; ðiː/|art.|这；那；所指的|基础|function-reference|the same::相同的;the next day::第二天|Please close the window before you leave.::离开前请关上窗户。|The book on the table belongs to me.::桌上的那本书是我的。
this|/ðɪs/|pron.; det.|这；这个|基础|function-reference|this morning::今天早上;this way::以这种方式|This is the place I told you about.::这就是我跟你说过的地方。|Can we finish this task before lunch?::我们能在午饭前完成这项任务吗？

that|/ðæt/|pron.; det.; conj.|那；那个；引出从句|基础|function-reference|that day::那一天;that kind of::那种|That house at the end of the street is empty.::街道尽头的那栋房子是空的。|I think that we should ask for help.::我认为我们应该寻求帮助。
it|/ɪt/|pron.|它；用于指代事物或作形式主语|基础|function-reference|it seems::似乎;take it easy::放轻松|I found your key and put it on the desk.::我找到了你的钥匙，把它放在了书桌上。|It takes ten minutes to walk to school.::步行到学校需要十分钟。
they|/ðeɪ/|pron.|他们；她们；它们|基础|function-reference|they say::人们说;they both::他们俩都|They usually meet at the library after class.::他们通常在课后到图书馆见面。|The shoes are nice, but they are too small.::这双鞋很好看，但它们太小了。
we|/wiː/|pron.|我们|基础|function-reference|we all::我们大家;we can::我们能够|We need more time to check the results.::我们需要更多时间来检查结果。|We often share books with our neighbors.::我们经常和邻居互相借阅书籍。
you|/juː/|pron.|你；你们；泛指人|基础|function-reference|thank you::谢谢你;you and I::你和我|You can leave your bag beside the door.::你可以把包放在门旁。|What would you like to do this weekend?::这个周末你想做什么？
he|/hiː/|pron.|他|基础|function-reference|he himself::他自己;he says::他说|He always checks the weather before leaving home.::他总是在出门前查看天气。|I asked him why he had changed his mind.::我问他为什么改变了主意。
she|/ʃiː/|pron.|她|基础|function-reference|she herself::她自己;she says::她说|She keeps a notebook beside her bed.::她在床边放着一本笔记本。|When she arrived, the meeting had already started.::她到达时，会议已经开始了。
and|/ənd; ænd/|conj.|和；并且|基础|function-links|you and me::你和我;again and again::一次又一次|Bring a pen and a notebook to the lesson.::上课时带一支笔和一本笔记本。|He opened the door and stepped outside.::他打开门，走到了外面。
or|/ɔːr/|conj.|或者；否则|基础|function-links|tea or coffee::茶或咖啡;sooner or later::迟早|Would you prefer to walk or take the bus?::你更愿意步行还是乘公交车？|Leave now, or you may miss the train.::现在就出发，否则你可能赶不上火车。

but|/bət; bʌt/|conj.; prep.|但是；除了|基础|function-links|small but useful::小但有用的;anything but::绝不是|The room is small but gets plenty of light.::房间虽小，但采光很好。|I wanted to help, but I did not know how.::我想帮忙，却不知道该怎么做。

because|/bɪˈkɔːz/|conj.|因为|基础|function-links|because of::由于;just because::仅仅因为|We stayed indoors because the rain was so heavy.::因为雨下得很大，我们待在了室内。|She chose this course because she enjoys history.::她选择这门课是因为她喜欢历史。
if|/ɪf/|conj.|如果；是否|基础|function-links|if necessary::如果有必要;even if::即使|If you need a break, just let me know.::如果你需要休息，告诉我就行。|I wonder if the shop is still open.::我想知道商店是否还开着。
when|/wen/|adv.; conj.|什么时候；当……时|基础|function-links|when possible::在可能的情况下;since when::从什么时候起|When does the next train leave the station?::下一班火车什么时候离站？|Call me when you get home tonight.::今晚到家时给我打电话。

while|/waɪl/|conj.; n.|在……期间；而；一段时间|基础|function-links|for a while::一会儿;once in a while::偶尔|Please keep quiet while the baby is sleeping.::婴儿睡觉时请保持安静。|I like the blue one, while she prefers green.::我喜欢蓝色的那个，而她更喜欢绿色。

before|/bɪˈfɔːr/|prep.; conj.; adv.|在……之前；以前|基础|function-links|before long::不久;the day before::前一天|Read the instructions carefully before using the machine.::使用机器前请仔细阅读说明。|I had never visited this city before.::我以前从未到过这座城市。

after|/ˈæftər/|prep.; conj.; adv.|在……之后；后来|基础|function-links|after school::放学后;look after::照顾|We went for a short walk after dinner.::晚饭后我们散了一小会儿步。|After the guests left, we cleaned the kitchen.::客人离开后，我们打扫了厨房。

as|/əz; æz/|prep.; conj.; adv.|作为；当……时；像……一样|基础|function-links|as usual::像往常一样;as a result::因此|She works as an engineer at a small company.::她在一家小公司担任工程师。|As the sun rose, the air grew warmer.::随着太阳升起，空气渐渐暖和起来。
with|/wɪð; wɪθ/|prep.|和……一起；带有；用|基础|function-relations|with care::小心地;agree with::同意|I went to the museum with my sister.::我和姐姐一起去了博物馆。|Please sign your name with a black pen.::请用黑色笔签上你的名字。

without|/wɪˈðaʊt/|prep.|没有；不带；不做某事|基础|function-relations|without doubt::毫无疑问;without help::没有帮助|You cannot enter the building without a pass.::没有通行证就不能进入大楼。|She finished the work without asking for help.::她没有寻求帮助就完成了工作。
of|/əv; ʌv/|prep.|……的；属于；其中的|基础|function-relations|a cup of tea::一杯茶;one of::……之一|The name of the street has recently changed.::这条街的名字最近改了。|One of my friends lives near the lake.::我的一个朋友住在湖边。
in|/ɪn/|prep.; adv.|在……里面；在某段时间内|基础|function-relations|in the room::在房间里;in time::及时|There are three apples in the bowl.::碗里有三个苹果。|I will return in a few minutes.::我几分钟后就回来。
on|/ɑːn/|prep.; adv.|在……上；在某日；进行中|基础|function-relations|on time::准时;on the table::在桌上|Put the clean plates on the top shelf.::把干净盘子放在最上层的架子上。|Our next meeting will be on Friday.::我们的下次会议将在周五举行。
at|/ət; æt/|prep.|在某处；在某时刻；以某种状态|基础|function-relations|at home::在家;at first::起初|Meet me at the main entrance at nine.::九点在正门与我见面。|She smiled at the child sitting beside her.::她朝坐在身旁的孩子笑了笑。

to|/tə; tuː/|prep.; part.|向；到；用于动词不定式|基础|function-relations|go to school::去上学;from time to time::不时|We walked to the station in the rain.::我们冒雨步行到了车站。|I want to learn something new every day.::我想每天都学一点新东西。

from|/frəm; frʌm/|prep.|从；来自；与……相隔|基础|function-relations|from now on::从现在起;learn from::向……学习|This letter is from a friend in Canada.::这封信来自一位在加拿大的朋友。|The walk from my home takes fifteen minutes.::从我家走过来需要十五分钟。

for|/fər; fɔːr/|prep.|为了；给；持续某段时间|基础|function-relations|for example::例如;for a long time::很长时间|I bought this notebook for my younger brother.::我给弟弟买了这本笔记本。|We waited for the bus for twenty minutes.::我们等公交车等了二十分钟。

than|/ðən; ðæn/|conj.; prep.|比|基础|function-relations|more than::超过;rather than::而不是|The journey took longer than we had expected.::旅途花的时间比我们预想的更长。|I would rather walk than wait for another bus.::我宁愿走路，也不愿再等一班公交车。
